topics.name: Uncertainty Quantification and Calibration
topics.summary: Post-hoc calibration, evidential models, selective prediction, ensemble confidence, and goodness-of-fit tests recur across language, medical, genomic, and tabular settings. The papers show that confidence is useful only when matched to distribution shift, coverage, and error structure.

topics.name: Language Model Reasoning and Evaluation
topics.summary: Controlled benchmarks, verifier-guided search, judge analysis, self-consistency tests, and structured reasoning traces examine how language models combine evidence and where scores misrepresent correctness. Results repeatedly expose sensitivity to task framing, model scale, and unsupported intermediate steps.

topics.name: Agent Orchestration and Tool Use
topics.summary: Agent runtimes combine reinforcement learning, readiness-aware scheduling, asynchronous tool execution, workflow construction, authentication gateways, and control-plane policies. Across research, data science, and infrastructure tasks, the recurring finding is that coordination and operational state strongly affect useful throughput.

topics.name: Agent Memory and Self-Evolving Systems
topics.summary: Persistent memories, provenance graphs, searchable skill cards, recursive prompt optimization, and executable skill harnesses let agents reuse prior work and repair accumulated state. Evaluations across coding, GUI, geospatial, mobile, and embodied tasks emphasize lower repeated effort and more stable long-horizon behavior.

topics.name: Safety and Reliability of Agentic Systems
topics.summary: Multi-agent failure attribution, red-team benchmarks, runtime contracts, deployment evaluation, and specialist-agent collaboration provide complementary checks on tool-enabled systems. The studies favor execution traces, calibrated risk estimates, and explicit accountability over single aggregate safety scores.

topics.name: Retrieval-Augmented Language Systems
topics.summary: Retrieval pipelines support assistive agents, long-document perception, patent matching, taxonomy expansion, scientific knowledge construction, and GUI grounding. The recurring methods select evidence, refine it at inference time, and evaluate whether retrieved context improves grounded decisions rather than merely longer responses.

topics.name: Efficient Language Model Inference and Adaptation
topics.summary: Token pruning, adaptive expert routing, KV-cache reuse, distillation, task-aware adapters, and deployment-regime tokenization reduce memory, communication, or retraining costs. Experiments across VLMs, edge serving, multimodal models, and compact language systems show benefits from retaining only task-relevant computation.

topics.name: AI Security and Adversarial Robustness
topics.summary: Backdoors, poisoning, model extraction, segmentation attacks, speech denial of service, multimodal jailbreaks, and agent vulnerabilities are evaluated with cross-domain benchmarks and targeted defenses. The findings stress that realistic attack delivery, contamination control, and behavioral testing matter beyond clean-set accuracy.

topics.name: Interpretability and Explainable AI
topics.summary: Causal tracing, feature attribution, Shapley-style explanations, operator-facing interfaces, and probes of learned representations are applied to UAV security, biology, remote sensing, medical imaging, and language models. Across settings, useful explanations require testing causal influence, stability, and audience fit.

topics.name: Vision-Language and Multimodal Grounding
topics.summary: Multimodal encoders, object-level alignment, gated fusion, visual presence, audio-visual QA, and stepwise disagreement checks connect language decisions to images, video, music, and medical records. Results repeatedly favor explicit cross-modal structure and evidence selection over undifferentiated feature fusion.

topics.name: Visual Recognition and Scene Understanding
topics.summary: Recognition systems address dynamic facial landmarks, identity perception, scene text, cross-modal detection, camouflage, topology-aware prototypes, and industrial segmentation. The common emphasis is on geometric variation, ambiguous evidence, and evaluation criteria that capture explanations or deployment conditions.

topics.name: Affective Computing and Human Behavior
topics.summary: Facial video, multimodal emotion models, empathetic dialogue, affective stance, evoked-emotion benchmarks, and relational engagement studies treat affect as temporally and socially situated. Datasets with sequence-level annotations and feedback loops improve recognition while revealing limits of isolated labels.

topics.name: Medical Imaging and Clinical AI
topics.summary: Clinical pipelines combine denoising, PET synthesis, mammography and polyp analysis, radiology reports, pathology field selection, ultrasound uncertainty, segmentation, and counterfactual explanations. Across modalities and datasets, calibration, label-efficient sampling, and clinically meaningful evidence are recurring requirements for transfer.

topics.name: Document Layout and Visual Analytics
topics.summary: Hierarchical document parsing, visual retrieval, layout generation, dashboard construction, and professional chart evaluation test whether models can recover structure and support real analytical workflows. Rendered feedback, selective resolution, and expert-authored cases expose weaknesses hidden by text-only or code-only scores.

topics.name: 3D Reconstruction and Spatial Scene Understanding
topics.summary: Gaussian splatting, depth-from-focus theory, geometric priors, primitive merging, camera pose estimation, structured-light sensing, and relative scene graphs reconstruct shape and object relations from sparse or dynamic observations. The methods improve consistency, compactness, and spatial reasoning under limited views.

topics.name: Temporal Video Generation and Understanding
topics.summary: Streaming diffusion, event-guided interpolation, autoregressive synthesis, dynamic memory, compressed-bitstream tracking, and audiovisual dialogue models address temporal coherence and bounded latency. Evaluations show that motion cues, causal history, and selective attention are important for long sequences.

topics.name: Image Restoration and Diffusion Models
topics.summary: Flow matching, discrete diffusion, dehazing, low-light correction, underwater enhancement, and adversarially guided generation cover restoration and synthesis from noisy or incomplete observations. The papers balance perceptual quality, physical consistency, few-step inference, and preservation of task-relevant structure.

topics.name: Learned Compression and Efficient Vision
topics.summary: Entropy-model experts, multiscale latents, packet-loss resilience, FPGA co-design, and I/O-aware convolutions reduce storage or execution cost for images, point clouds, SAR data, and neural networks. Results show that input-aware allocation and graceful degradation improve practical deployment.

topics.name: Embodied Robot Learning and Manipulation
topics.summary: Bimanual grasping, world-action models, semantic 3D grounding, deformable manipulation, skill transfer, surgical learning, and minimal-data policy adaptation combine demonstrations with closed-loop control. The recurring goal is robust behavior with less labeling, fewer interventions, and better transfer across platforms.

topics.name: Autonomous Driving and Traffic Safety
topics.summary: Latent world models, failure memories, threat-guided perturbations, cross-view localization, scenario diffusion, neuro-symbolic guards, and relational Q-learning target rare or hazardous driving situations. Results support safety-focused experience generation but show that detecting threats does not by itself guarantee adaptive control.

topics.name: Aerial Robotics and Haptic Interaction
topics.summary: UAV tracking, drone docking, vocal teleoperation, compliant aerial manipulation, wearable surface haptics, and robotic ultrasound use motion compensation, admittance control, and tactile or visual feedback. Experiments indicate that lightweight sensing and assistance can improve precision without eliminating operator agency.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning and Optimal Control
topics.summary: Online adaptation, federated exploration, stochastic control, restart policies, safety filters, HVAC optimization, hypergradient learning, and waiting decisions address control under uncertainty and limited feedback. The methods improve sample use or constraint handling while exposing sensitivity to drift and reward design.

topics.name: Time-Series Forecasting and Dynamical Systems
topics.summary: Probabilistic forecasting, conformal correction, neural differential models, temporal graphs, physiological monitoring, geographic progression, and energy-market prediction model changing processes over long horizons. The studies emphasize calibrated intervals, efficient training, and robustness to missing, shifted, or structured observations.

topics.name: Scientific Machine Learning and Quantum Computing
topics.summary: Physics-informed neural networks, geometric operators, finite-difference derivatives, quantum state prototypes, measurement design, and latent physical surrogates connect learning with governing structure. Applications span conservation laws, inverse problems, quantum control, and medical reconstruction under data or hardware limits.

topics.name: Combinatorial Optimization and Operations Research
topics.summary: Submodular optimization, belief-function approximation, dispatch, contextual bandits with knapsacks, assortment decisions, numerical solvers, and task-vector correction address resource allocation with changing constraints. The recurring methods trade exactness, cost, and reoptimization speed for deployable solutions.

topics.name: Graph Learning and Knowledge Representation
topics.summary: Graph rewiring, ontology-aware ingestion, topology-text prototypes, rail-transit knowledge graphs, spectral clustering, logic tensor networks, network verification, and relational explanations preserve structure that flat features lose. Evaluations emphasize graph quality, anomaly detection, and interpretable relational inference.

topics.name: Recommender Systems and Ranking
topics.summary: Popularity dynamics, click-intent decomposition, cross-domain federation, time-aware routing, group-ranking audits, model merging, and memory-budgeted training examine recommendation under heterogeneous feedback. Results show that tie handling, stale signals, and user-specific interests can materially change reported gains.

topics.name: Causal Inference and Statistical Discovery
topics.summary: Conditional-independence testing, identifiability from private reports, intervention ranking, scattering constraints, and multivariate validation connect causal structure with decisions under partial information. The work highlights how assumptions, measurement design, and intervention costs affect graph recovery and applied conclusions.

topics.name: Learning Theory and Neural Optimization
topics.summary: Tensor estimation, randomized sketches, PAC-style guarantees, spectral embeddings, attention expressivity, variational inference, and neural convergence provide sample, rate, or stability analyses. These results clarify when structural assumptions improve learnability and where optimization or representation complexity remains limiting.

topics.name: Multilingual NLP and Cross-Lingual Learning
topics.summary: Multilingual speech and text corpora, routing for low-resource classification, machine translation, policy retention, safety audits, and text-to-image generation measure uneven transfer across languages. The studies find that aggregate multilingual scores conceal language-specific failures in quality, safety, and behavior.

topics.name: Speech, Audio, Sign Language, and Gesture
topics.summary: TTS round-trip audits, whispered and clinical ASR, turn-state prediction, piano representations, sign spotting, iterative translation, and speech-driven gesture generation use specialized corpora and temporal supervision. Findings stress robustness to noise, convention, annotation scarcity, and conversational timing.

topics.name: Creative AI, Education, and Human-AI Collaboration
topics.summary: Narrative keyframing, therapeutic music interfaces, serious games, educational fiction, mathematical collaboration, programmable learning environments, and interaction-trait analysis study creativity and learning with human partners. User studies repeatedly value controllability, coherence, reflection, and context-sensitive assistance.

topics.name: Social Computing and AI Governance
topics.summary: Rulemaking audits, legal-scope analysis, newsroom adoption, national policy comparison, digital accessibility, data trust, online stigma, influence campaigns, and institutional coordination examine AI in social settings. Mixed-method evidence shows that participation, authority, and organizational context shape outcomes beyond model capability.

topics.name: Biomedical, Molecular, and Materials Modeling
topics.summary: Dynamic protein interaction data, molecular property prediction, crystallographic inference, PROTAC degradation, chemical-agent environments, reaction-network computation, drug-response modeling, and constrained hit discovery combine domain structure with language or generative models. Evaluation centers on transfer, interpretability, and experimentally relevant constraints.

topics.name: Remote Sensing and Geospatial AI
topics.summary: Open-vocabulary segmentation, structural prompts, SAR representations, agricultural monitoring, building and photovoltaic mapping, and geospatial retrieval adapt vision models to sparse labels and difficult imagery. Results highlight the value of geometry, cross-modal guidance, and transfer across sites and sensors.

topics.name: Wireless Sensing and Signal Processing
topics.summary: LPWAN path-loss prediction, maritime sensing, interference-aware sensor selection, and related physical-layer models use terrain, frequency, and location features to guide deployment decisions. Experiments emphasize gateway or site transfer and low-cost sensing under changing propagation conditions.

topics.name: Machine Learning Systems and Hardware
topics.summary: Systems-aware scaling, CNN cost prediction, sparse-expert deployment, robot recomposition, industrial anomaly monitoring, and hardware co-design connect model choices to memory, latency, payload, and operational constraints. Measurements show that cluster or device behavior can differ substantially from proxy benchmarks.

topics.name: Language Data Provenance and Corpus Auditing
topics.summary: Prototype-based text detection, post-training feature-shift analysis, sampled token statistics, vocabulary inspection, and generated-text benchmarks audit how language-model corpora and outputs are formed. The methods favor lightweight sampling and representation diagnostics over exhaustive corpus access.

topics.name: AI Benchmarks and Dataset Construction
topics.summary: New datasets and evaluation suites cover charts, eye tracking, human action, music, HRI, feature matching, augmentation, sign language, gaze, scientific reasoning, mobile agents, poetry-to-image generation, and noisy-label learning. Across domains, structured annotations and task-specific protocols reveal failures hidden by generic scores.
